description: This Java class implements a log filter node that outputs only log messages without metadata, suitable for simplified on-screen log display. It implements the LogNode interface and provides mechanisms to set and retrieve the next node in the log chain.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A log filter node that outputs only the log message content, ignoring other metadata like priority, tag, and throwable.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the log filter with the next node in the chain.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Default constructor with no initialization of the next node.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs the message to the next log node, suppressing other metadata.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
